notes.title: Update: Fixed Invisible Boss Bug!
notes.content: [p][b]Update: Fixed Invisible Boss Bug![/b] Quick update! We squashed a bug where the [b]Slime King, Gun Flower, and Bee Hive[/b] could sometimes become invisible, making them impossible to hit with melee attacks. [b]They should now stay visible and fightable![/b] Restart the game if the update doesn't apply automatically. Thanks for your support![/p]

notes.title: Pixel Dungeon v2.30 Update is Live!
notes.content:
# 📢 Pixel Dungeon v2.30 Update is Live!
Hey adventurers!
We’ve just rolled out v2.30 with a couple of quality-of-life improvements — especially for content creators and dungeon masters alike:
🆕 **LIV Camera Integration**
We’ve added LIV camera support to help more creators easily record in-game footage content. Allowing selfie, FPOV, and 3rd person view. Capture your dungeon runs in style and bring your content to life with enhanced visuals!
🗺️ **Quest Completion Platform Upgrade**
The end-game summary platform now shows the map name and difficulty level you conquered. Share your achievements with the full glory of context!
As always, thanks for your support and keep those dungeon runs coming. If you encounter any issues or have feedback, drop us a message here!
Happy crawling!

notes.title: 🚨 Pixel Dungeon is Officially Live! 🚨
notes.content:
We’re beyond excited to finally launch Pixel Dungeon in its full version! 🎉 Thank you so much for your patience and support — we couldn’t have made it here without you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184253/622a298cf9b7fc90013831d218df6e9bf95d9db0.png[/img]

notes.title: PATCH NOTES 25/2/14
notes.content:
[h1]🆕 Pixel Dungeon Update[/h1]
[h3] 🎮Feature Updates:[/h3]
1. Added melee swing damage for shields. Similar to other melee weapons, the damage depends on the swing speed.
2. Added melee damage for the longbow, crossbow, throwing darts, and staff, with a fixed damage of 1 point.
3. Optimized the scaling effect for hit effects of the above-mentioned weapons.
[h3] Bug Fixes:[/h3]
- Fixed an issue where player levels in the multiplayer lobby were sometimes displayed incorrectly.
- Fixed an issue where the controller vibration for the staff didn’t cancel after the player died.
- Fixed an issue where some settings in the settings menu weren’t saved correctly.
- Fixed an issue where some floating UI characters were missing.
- Fixed an issue where the Fallen Angel Boss's position was incorrect when entering the second phase.
- Fixed an issue where the meteor/harpoon animation summoned by the Fallen Angel Boss behaved abnormally.
- Fixed an issue where the Skeleton King Boss got stuck in an invincible state and didn’t move, or remained invincible.

Join our discord for more: https://discord.gg/pdvr

notes.title: Important Notice for All Players
notes.content:
We’ve noticed that due to the latest Meta update, Steam users may be on an outdated version of the game. As a result, while single-player mode should work fine, multiplayer may experience several issues, such as:
- Incorrect weapon positions
- Monsters appearing in the multiplayer lobby
- Mismatched monster appearance and abilities in dungeons
To avoid these issues, we recommend playing single-player mode until the update is applied. We expect Steam to have the update ready by tomorrow afternoon, though it may take until tomorrow evening in some cases.

Thank you for your understanding, and we appreciate your patience!

notes.title: Common Player Feedback Q&A Since the Prologue Update
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Thank you for your continued support and feedback since the release of the Prologue Update for Pixel Dungeon: Prologue. We appreciate your engagement and want to address some common questions and concerns raised by our community.

[h1]1. Christmas Event Participation[/h1]

The Christmas event is [b]accessible to all users,[/b] whether they are on Meta or Steam. Join the discord and follow the direction. We are attaching discord anouncement for your reference: https://discord.com/channels/1233268144177414185/1263016261340758078/1320930514491670600. We hope you participate and enjoy the festivities!

[b]An inportant takeaway is that after clicking the event button within the game, which will open in your computer's browser, you'll need to continue from there.[/b]

[h1]2. Progress Reset for Some Players[/h1]

We regret to inform our players that during the login period from December 21 to December 24, Pixel Dungeon: Prologue experienced an issue where 109 players had their progress reset. We sincerely apologize for this inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.

[b]To compensate affected players, we are offering the following rewards:

- 1000 Gold Coins
- Avatars: 10, 14, 17, 19, 20
- Weapons:
   All 1-star weapons
   Five 2-star initial weapons
   One 2-star dart
   One 2-star heavy sword[/b]

[b]Upon entering the online lobby, players will receive a toast notification. In their respective rooms, a purple stone will appear; breaking this stone will grant all compensation rewards.[/b]

For players who did not log in during this period, your game progress remains intact.

Again, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and hope you will continue to enjoy Pixel Dungeon: Prologue and have a great gaming experience.

notes.title: 🚨Multiplayer Update for Pixel Dungeon Prologue! 🚨
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce a significant update for Pixel Dungeon Prologue, and we can’t wait for you to experience the latest additions! As a thank you for your support, we’re introducing several exciting features to enhance your gameplay experience.


[h2]🎮 What’s New in Pixel Dungeon Prologue:[/h2]
[h3]Level Cap and Content Overview:[/h3]
The Prologue currently mirrors the content available in the Demo version on our Pixel Dungeon page. In the Prologue, players are limited to level 10 for progression. However, this limitation doesn’t hold you back from enjoying all of the exciting content:
[list]
[*]
[/list]Dozens of Monsters and Elite Boss Fights: Prepare to battle a variety of unique monsters and elite bosses, each with their own distinctive attack patterns and strategies. These encounters require tactical thinking and mastery of the game’s mechanics to overcome.
[list]
[*]
[/list]Puzzle-filled Maps: Each dungeon is filled with secrets and hidden areas that challenge your wit and intelligence. Solve puzzles, unlock hidden paths, and discover the lore behind the monsters and dungeons.
[list]
[*]
[/list]Weapon and Upgrade Systems: Collect and use a variety of weapons, each with its own properties and upgrade options. Upgrade your gear to become stronger, defeat tougher enemies, and gain access to new abilities.
[list]
[*]
[/list]Two Intense Boss Fights: Fight your way through two unique boss battles, each designed with intricate combat mechanics. The deeper you dive into the game, the more complex the strategies you’ll need to employ to overcome these foes.
[list]
[*]
[/list]Exclusive Christmas Event: Celebrate the holiday season with special Christmas-themed skins. These festive skins are limited-time only and add a unique visual flair to your gameplay.
[url=https://discord.gg/Wt7V5tMXCM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184253/690fc9f736708a0020f62aecb4930e4df28b8d18.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]🎄 How to Join the Fun:[/h2]

1. Experience Free Multiplayer Gameplay: [b]Join our Discord [/b]community to receive an exclusive code to unlock multiplayer mode in the Prologue. Play with your friends and tackle dungeons together!

2. Unlock Exclusive Avatars and Skins: Participate in special in-game tasks to earn Christmas-themed avatars and skins. These limited-time rewards are available only during the holiday event!

3. Team Up with Others: Explore dungeons together in multiplayer mode and enjoy the game with your friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184253/119856d64949017253c25a709ae043aea425f19a.png[/img]
